metadata.case_name: WONG KAI FUN v. SUN ON LOGISTICS LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.education_level: Secondary education level up to Form 5

injuries.description: Severe head injury including concussion, intracranial haemorrhages and contusions
source: I find that the plaintiff suffered a severe head injury with mild adjustment disorder as a result of the Accident.
he was found to have had a concussion, hemorrhage in the brain, fractured temporal bones, and showed signs of vomiting and amnesia.
he was found to have had a concussion, hemorrhage in the brain, fractured temporal bones, and showed signs of vomiting and amnesia.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of middle fossa of base of skull

injuries.description: Bilateral post injury haemotympanum causing bilateral mild conductive hearing loss
source: Bilateral post injury haemotympanum causing bilateral mild conductive hearing loss was diagnosed.
When he was reviewed on 24 July 2012 in the out‑patient clinic, bilateral haemotympanum was completely resolved and there was no more conductive hearing loss on the pure tone audiogram.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of middle or inner ear

injuries.description: Bilateral post injury benign paroxysmal positioning vertigo
source: Dix‑Hallpike examination confirmed that he had bilateral post injury bengin paroxysmal positioning vertigo.

source: he still complained of post injury bilateral postural vertigo and bilateral episodic low tone non-pulsatile tinnitus.

injuries.description: Adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressive reaction
source: The plaintiff was diagnosed to have suffered from adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressive reaction.

injuries.description: Extraaxial hematoma in left frontal region (could be subdural or epidural hematoma)
source: Extraaxial hematoma in left frontal region, could be subdural or epidural hematoma.

manifestations.description: Loss of consciousness (at time of fall)
Blurred eyesight / intermittent blurring of vision
Auditory hallucination / symptoms of organic hallucinations
Bilateral episodic low tone non-pulsatile tinnitus

treatments_received: Admitted to the Accident and Emergency Unit of Tuen Mun Hospital
Referred to the Department of Neurosurgery for further examination and treatment

CT scan of the brain performed (showing bilateral subarachnoid haemorrhage; subdural haemorrhage overlying right cerebrum and along bilateral tentorium; hyperdense contusions in left frontal and right temporal lobes; extraaxial hematoma in left frontal region)
Seen at the Department of Ear, Nose and Throat of Tuen Mun Hospital; bilateral Epley’s maneuver performed
Attended the Department of Ophthalmology of Tuen Mun Hospital (intermittent blurring of vision; best‑corrected visual acuity 6/6 both eyes on 19 September 2012)
Attended 4 sessions of occupational therapy between 12 June 2012 and 8 January 2013
Sick leave certificates granted for the period from 27 March 2012 to 18 July 2014

losses.description: Occasionally suffering from loss of concentration and memory and cognitive impairment as a result of the head injury
Has not been able to return to his pre‑injury job as a container‑truck driver
Bilateral mild conductive hearing loss diagnosed after the Accident (resolved by 24 July 2012)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Occasional dizziness and headaches affecting activities
